tools.name: search_braindrops
tools.description: Search BrainDrops AI art collections and pieces by title, artist, collection, trait, or "collection number" (e.g. "loops 42", "podgans 6"). Returns matching collections and pieces with links.

tools.name: get_piece
tools.description: Get one BrainDrops piece: name, artist, collection, traits, images, and every permanent copy (Ethereum token, Arweave metadata, Arweave HD image, IPFS original). Give token_id, or collection + number.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one BrainDrops collection: artist, size, release date, background, facts, token ID range, OpenSea link and Arweave archive manifests.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List every BrainDrops collection with artist, size and release date.

tools.name: list_collectors
tools.description: The BrainDrops collector leaderboard: collector profiles with how many pieces and collections they hold, set badges (complete set, Day One) and per-collection counts. Filter by collection or name; sort by pieces, collections, newest or name.

tools.name: get_collector
tools.description: Get one collector profile (braindrops.art/collector/{slug}) with every BrainDrops piece it holds, counts per collection and set badges. Wallet addresses are included only if the collector shows them publicly.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: List the BrainDrops pieces held by an Ethereum address (0x…), with counts per collection, set badges and the collector profile it belongs to if public.

tools.name: get_holders
tools.description: Rank who holds a BrainDrops collection, grouping wallets that belong to one collector profile.

tools.name: get_traits
tools.description: Every trait in a BrainDrops collection with each value's count and percentage, for rarity questions.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Platform totals: collections, pieces, artists, unique wallets, collector profiles, complete and Day One sets, and holders per collection.

tools.name: get_archive_info
tools.description: Explain how BrainDrops art is permanently preserved (Ethereum, Arweave, IPFS pinning, offline archives) and how to verify a copy.
